{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
num_duplicates = duplicate_patients.sum()

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()

# Check association between arm and severity
crosstab_arm_severity = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['severity'])

# Print findings
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id rows: {num_duplicates}')
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline}')
print('\nCrosstab of arm vs severity:\n', crosstab_arm_severity)"}
